Merci de ne pas soumettre immédiatement.en:
Please do not immediately submit the form before reassuring yourself that you are not going to see the patient for this follow-up.
Ask if the patient will be present at another time of the day.
Return to another time of day if necessary to meet with the patient.
Talk to the patient or other family members to better plan future follow-up visits.
Submit the form before the end of the day if, despite your best efforts, you cannot find the patient on site.

Penser à la tuberculose de l'enfant et f.en: Think about tuberculosis in children with the following signs: cough, fever, weight loss, night sweats. Also look for other signs such as: respiratory difficulties, pleural/pericardial/peritoneal effusion, lymphadenopathy especially cervical, neck stiffness, bone deformities in the spine or joints.
Penser à la tuberculose de l'enfant et f.bm: Penser à la tuberculose de l'enfant et faire une investigation diagnostique devant un des signes suivants : une toux, une fièvre, une perte de poids, des sueurs nocturnes. Mais rechercher éventuellement d'autres signes tels que : des difficultés respiratoires, épanchement des séreuses (plèvre, péricarde, péritoine), adénopathies surtout cervicales, une raideur de la nuque, déformations osseuses au niveau de la colonne vertébrale ou des articulations.

Appeler le patient pour l'informer du ré.en:
- Call the patient to inform them of the negative result of your tuberculosis test.
- Invite the patient to go to the CSCOM to retrieve his result and be reconsulted by a provider.
- Invite the patient to give the information to his CHW.
- If possible, inform the ASC and their supervisor of the patient's result.
Appeler le patient pour l'informer du ré.bm:
- Appeler le patient pour l'informer du résultat négatif de son test tuberculose.
- Inviter le patient à passer au CSCOM pour récupérer son résultat et se faire reconsulter par un prestataire.
- Inviter le patient à donner l'information à son ASC.
- Si possible informer l'ASC et son superviseur du résultat du patient.

- Appeler le patient pour l'informer du.en:
- Call the patient to inform them of the positive result of their tuberculosis test.
- Reassure the patient and invite them to come to the health center to begin treatment.
- If possible, inform the CHW and their supervisor of the patient's result and invite them to take action for the rest of the activities (NB: Messages should be received by CHWs and CHW supervisors in the form of tasks).
- Appeler le patient pour l'informer du.bm:
- Appeler le patient pour l'informer du résultat positif de son test tuberculose.
- Rassurer le patient et l'inviter à passer au centre de santé pour commencer le traitement.
- Si possible informer l'ASC et son superviseur du résultat du patient et les inviter à prendre des actions pour le reste des activités (NB: Des messages devraient être reçus par les ASC et les superviseurs des ASC sous forme de taches).

Apprenez à la femme à reconnaître les si.en:
Teach the woman to recognize the danger signs. 
Talk to the woman about the importance of ANC. 
Remind the woman of the date of the next ANC.
Apprenez à la femme à reconnaître les si.bm: Muso kalan taamasiɲɛn jugumanw lakodɔni la. Kumaɲɔyaw kɛ muso fɛ peseli nafaw kan. Muso hakili jigi a ka peseli nata don la. A ɲinni ka dɔ cogobɛla ni muso ye a ka jolitaw bɛkɛ.

Apprenez à la femme à reconnaître les si.en:
Teach the woman to recognize the danger signs. 
Talk to the woman about the importance of ANC. 
Discuss the benefits of giving birth in a health center. 
Teach the woman to recognize the signs of labor and childbirth.
Apprenez à la femme à reconnaître les si.bm: Muso kalan taamasiɲɛn jugumanw lakodɔni la. Kumaɲɔyaw kɛ muso fɛ peseli nafaw kan. Kumaɲɔyaw kɛ muso fɛ kɛnɛyaso jigini nafaw kan. Muso kalan n'ti taamasiɲɛn dɔni la.

Apprenez à la femme à reconnaître les si.en:
Teach the woman to recognize the danger signs. 
Talk to the woman about the importance of ANC. 
Discuss preparing for childbirth. 
Give advice on family planning and help the woman choose a method to use after giving birth.
Apprenez à la femme à reconnaître les si.bm: Muso kalan taamasiɲɛn jugumanw lakodɔni la. Kumaɲɔyaw kɛ muso fɛ peseli nafaw kan. Kumaɲɔyaw kɛ muso fɛ jiginni labɛni baaraw kan. Kunafoniw di muso ma bange furancɛ janɲali fɛrɛw kan ani ka dɛmɛ ka fɛrɛ dɔ suganti a bese ka m'u kɛ na jigina.

Encouragez la femme à aller faire sa CPN.en: Encourage the woman to go for her ANC, as this helps to minimize the risk to her and her baby, and to ensure a healthy and safe pregnancy and delivery.
Encouragez la femme à aller faire sa CPN.bm: Muso nɛgɛ a kata CPN kɛ, kadakan o bɛ muso ni den bɛ tagan, wa o debɛ kɔnɔmaya ni jigini bɛ nɔgɔya.

Une dose de SP a déjà été administrée. F.en:
One dose of MS has already been administered. Congratulate the woman on this dose of MS! 
It is important to receive at least 3 doses of MS during pregnancy, according to the WHO. MS can prevent malaria during pregnancy and reduce complications in pregnant women, fetuses, and newborns.
Une dose de SP a déjà été administrée. F.bm:
Muso ye SP dɔn ta kaban. I ba fo o la.
A fɔ muso ye k'a kanka SP ta ko saba (3) de kɛ kɔnɔmaya kɔnɔ. O y'a dɔgɔyale ye OMS ka fɔ la.
SP kunuli de be muso ni a den tagan sumaya ma kɔnɔmaya kɔnɔ. 
A be muso ni a kɔnɔ denw kisi kasara caman wɛrɛ ma.

Il est important de recevoir au moins 3.en:
It is important to receive at least 3 doses of MS during pregnancy, according to the WHO. 
MS can prevent malaria during pregnancy and reduce complications in pregnant women, fetuses, and newborns. 
Advise the woman to seek MS at her next ANC.
Il est important de recevoir au moins 3.bm:
A fo muso ka kanka SP ta ko saba (3) de kɛ kɔnɔmaya kɔnɔ. O y'a dɔgɔyale ye OMS ka fɔ la.
SP kunuli de be muso ni a den tagan sumaya ma kɔnɔmaya kɔnɔ. 
A be muso ni a kɔnɔ denw kisi kasara caman wɛrɛ ma.
A fɔ muso ye, a ka CPN wɛrɛ la a ka SP ɲinigali kɛ CSCOM la.

Veuillez soumettre ce formulaire et util.en: Please submit this form and use the form "Evaluation of Children + 5 years of age and Adults" to carry out the evaluation of this pregnant woman, due to the presence (or notion) of fever, without signs of danger related to pregnancy.
Veuillez soumettre ce formulaire et util.bm: Ni sɛbɛn bila kata i ka makɔrɔbaw ka kimɛli sɛbɛn ta ka muso kimɛ n'o ye kadakan a fari ka kalan walima a tun ka kalan kunu walima kununa sini. N'ga kɔnɔmaya taamasiɲɛn juguman tala.

L’albendazole donné pendant la grossesse.en: Albendazole given during pregnancy helps protect the mother and baby from intestinal worms that can cause a lack of blood that leads to a lot of problems during pregnancy and after childbirth. It is important to take the recommended dose during pregnancy to be protected against these intestinal worms. The next time she visits the health centre, remember to ask if albendazole is available so that she can take it.
L’albendazole donné pendant la grossesse.bm:
Albɛndazɔli tali bɛ den ni ba kisi tumu misɛniw ma, tumu minu bɛse ka joli dɛsɔ se muso ma kɔnɔmaya kɔnɔ walima jigini kɔfɔ.
Muso kanka Albɛndazɔli hakɛ kofɔlen ta walasa ka kisi o tumu nunu ma.
Muso ka tali wɛrɛ la CSCOM la a kanka Albɛndazɔli ɲinigali kɛ walasa ka ta.

Le fer protège la santé de la maman et d.en: Iron protects the health of mom and baby and helps the baby grow well. Not taking iron can cause anemia, great fatigue and increase the risk of complications during and after childbirth. Even if some iron can sometimes give bothersome effects, it is important to continue taking it every day for her well-being and that of the baby. If she has difficulties or concerns, let's talk about them together to find a solution together.
Le fer protège la santé de la maman et d.bm:
Fɛri furakisɛ tali bɛ muso ni den kisi joli dɛsɛ ma wa a be den kɔrɔbaya cogo ɲɛ. Muso kɔnɔma kanka Fɛri furakisɛ ta don ko don walasa ka kisi degun misɛw ma inafɔ joli dɛsɛ, a farikolo sɛgɛko jugu...
Ni Fɛri furakisɛ tali be degun se muso ma a ka o fɔ i ye, i ka bilasira.

L'enfant n'a jamais été vacciné\nRappele.en:
The child has never been vaccinated
Remind the parent that regular monitoring of vaccinations is the surest way to prevent illness.
Encourage the parent to bring the child to start their vaccination as soon as possible.
 Help parents choose a date for this purpose.
L'enfant n'a jamais été vacciné\nRappele.bm:
Den ma deli ka boloci kɛ
Bangebagaw hakili jigin ko bolociw kɔlɔsili tuma bɛɛ ani a waati la, o de be Den kisi banaw caama man.
Ɲɛfɔlikɛ kɔsɛbɛ bangebagaw ye walasa u ka Den ka boloci daminɛ.
Bangebagaw dɛmɛ u ka don dɔ sugandi o kama.

L'enfant n'a jamais été vacciné\nRappele.en:
The child has never been vaccinated
Remind the parents that regular monitoring of vaccinations is the surest way to prevent disease.
Encourage the parents to bring the child to start his vaccination.
Help the parents to choose a date for this effect.
In case of refusal, please inform your supervisor to support you in raising awareness.
If the refusal persists, please close the task.
L'enfant n'a jamais été vacciné\nRappele.bm:
Den ma deli ka boloci kɛ
Bangebagaw hakili jigin ko bolociw kɔlɔsili tuma bɛɛ ani a waati la, o de be Den kisi banaw caama man.
Ɲɛfɔlikɛ kɔsɛbɛ bangebagaw ye walasa u ka Den ka boloci daminɛ.
Bangebagaw dɛmɛ u ka don dɔ sugandi o kama.
Ni u banna, i k’a fɔ i ka sipɛwisɛri ye walasa a k’i dɛmɛ ka bangebagaw bila hakili na ɲunman kan.
Ni u mason pewu pewu, a ɲin ni nen do i ka ni kɔlɔsili datugu.

La fillette n'a pas reçu le vaccin HPV R.en: The girl has not received the HPV vaccine Remind the parents that this vaccine helps prevent cervical cancer. Encourage them to take the girl to the health centre to receive the vaccine as soon as possible. Help the parents choose a date for the vaccination. If refusal occurs, please inform your supervisor to support you in outreach. If refusal persists, please close the task.
La fillette n'a pas reçu le vaccin HPV R.bm: Sunkuruni ma HPV boloci sɔrɔ Bangebagaw hakili jigin ko nin boloci in bɛ Sunkuruni tanga bana jugu ma. Ɲɛfɔlikɛ kɔsɛbɛ bangebagaw ye walasa u ka taa ni Sunkuruni ye kɛnɛyaso la joona walasa a ka HPV boloci sɔrɔ. Bangebagaw dɛmɛ u ka don dɔ sugandi boloci in kama. Ni u banna, i k’a fɔ i ka sipɛwisɛri ye walasa a k’i dɛmɛ ka bangebagaw bila hakili na ɲunman kan. Ni u mason pewu pewu, a ɲin ni nen do i ka ni kɔlɔsili datugu.

L'enfant n'a pas reçu tous les vaccins l.en:
The child has not received all vaccines related to his age.
Remind the parents that regular monitoring of vaccinations is the surest way to prevent disease.
Encourage the parents to bring the child to complete his vaccination.
Help the parents to choose a date for this effect.
L'enfant n'a pas reçu tous les vaccins l.bm:
Den ma boloci bɛɛ sɔrɔ min bɛ tali kɛ a si hakɛ la

Bangebagaw dɛmɛ u ka don dɔ sugandi o kama.

L'enfant n'a pas reçu tous les vaccins l.en:
Child has not received all age-related immunizations.
Remind the parent that regular immunization follow-up is the safest way to prevent disease.
Encourage the parent to bring the child in to complete the immunization as soon as possible.
If refusal occurs, please inform your supervisor to support you in outreach.
If refusal persists, please close the task.
L'enfant n'a pas reçu tous les vaccins l.bm:
Den ma a si boloci bɛ sɔrɔ.
Den masaw hakijigi boloci matarafali ni dafali nafaw la.
Den masaw deli u kata ni den ye dɔgɔtɔrɔla walasa k’a boloci dafa jona.
N’u masɔ i bɛ i ka sipɛriwisɛri kunnafoni jona walasa o ki dɛmɛ ku kumaɲɔgɔya.
N’u masɔ o bɛla i bɛ bara datugu.

L'enfant n'a pas de carnet de vaccinatio.en:
The child does not have a vaccination card
Give advice to the parents on the need to have their vaccination record and tell them that this is the only proof of whether your child is vaccinated or not.
Encourage the parents to bring the child to have a vaccination record.
Help the parents to choose a date for this effect.

Boloci sɛben te Den bolo
Ɲɛfɔlikɛ bangebagaw ye, Denw ka boloci sɛbɛn nafa kan ani k’a fɔ u ye ko nin sɛbɛn dɔrɔn de ye dalilu ye min b’a jira ko u Den bolocilen don walima ni a ma ci.
Ɲɛfɔlikɛ kɔsɛbɛ bangebagaw ye walasa u ka Den ka boloci sɛben ko ɲannabɔ

Informez le patient du résultat négatif.en: Inform the patient of the negative result and ensure they understand the importance of monitoring symptoms. Inform them that their chemoprevention follow-up will continue and encourage them to consult a doctor in case of persistent or new symptoms.

Se rendre chez l'ASC si un membre de vot.bm: A ye ta ASC ka so n'aw man kɛnɛ

Communiquer avec vos voisins et amis : L.bm: Aw ye to ka sumaya kunbɛ cogo baro fɛrɛ baro kɛ aw somɔgɔw ani aw sigiɲɔgɔw fɛ.

Prévention des maladies diarrhéiques (hy.en: Prevention of diarrhoeal diseases (hygiene, sanitation, proper hand washing, etc.)
Prévention des maladies diarrhéiques (hy.bm: Kɔnɔboli kunbɛ cogo fɛɛrɛw ( saniya, jɛya, tɛgɛko cogo ɲuman )

Laver vos mains au savon régulièrement,.en: Wash your hands with soap regularly, especially after using the toilet and before preparing or eating food.
Laver vos mains au savon régulièrement,.bm: Aw ye aw tɛgɛko ka jɛ, kɛrɛkɛrɛleyala n'aw bora ɲɛgɛla ani yani aw ka tobili walima dumuni kɛ.

Maintenez votre environnement propre: Li.en: Maintain your clean environment: Places, ustemsiles...
Maintenez votre environnement propre: Li.bm: Aw ye aw ka dukɔnɔnaw ni sigidaw saniya ani aw ka barakɛ minɛw...

Boire de l’eau potable et laver soigneus.en: Drink potable water and wash fruits and vegetables thoroughly before eating.
Boire de l’eau potable et laver soigneus.bm: Aw ye ji sanuma min. Aw ye yiridenw ni nakɔlafɛw saniya yani aw ku dun.

La Consultation Prénatale (CPN) est esse.en: The Prenatal Consultation (ANC) is essential to monitor the health of the mother and the fetus throughout the pregnancy. It helps to detect and prevent complications so that the mother can give birth safely.
La Consultation Prénatale (CPN) est esse.bm: Peseli ba to muso ni den ka kɛnɛya bɛ jateminɛ kɔnɔmaya kɔnɔ. A b'a to muso bɛ jigi hɛrɛla ani den bɛ kisi banajuguw ma.

Après la naissance, la Consultation Post.en: After birth, the Postnatal Consultation (ONCP) allows the health of the mother and newborn to be checked, to detect any problems quickly, and to accompany the mother in the care of the baby.
Après la naissance, la Consultation Post.bm:
Jigini kɔfɛ lajɛli (CPON) ba t'o muso ni den la kɛnɛya bɛ lajɛ. Ni bana b'u la o bɛ dɔn jona. 
Jigini kɔfɛ lajɛli (CPON) sefɛ muso bɛ dege denyɛrɛni tɔbɔtɔli la.

Commencer tôt vos CPN et suivez-les : un.en: Starting your ANCs early and following them: a simple gesture for a healthy baby!
Commencer tôt vos CPN et suivez-les : un.bm: Peseli daminɛli jona walasa ka den kɛnɛman sɔrɔ !

La CPN prépare la famille à l'accoucheme.en: The NPC prepares the family for childbirth, providing counselling on nutrition and family planning, thereby reducing the risk of maternal and child mortality.
La CPN prépare la famille à l'accoucheme.bm: Peseli matarafali bɛ duden bɛ laben jigini la, kadakan ladilikanw bɛ di balocogo ɲuman ani bange furancɛ janyanli fɛrɛw kan. O ba to denyɛrɛni saya ani den saya bɛ dɔgɔya.

Chaque vaccin compte, ne laissez pas les.en: Every vaccine counts, don't let diseases decide your children's future.
Chaque vaccin compte, ne laissez pas les.bm: Boloci fura bɛ na nafa do, an ka denw boloci walasa k'u kisi bana ma.

Respecter le calendrier vaccinal, c’est.en: Respecting the vaccination schedule means guaranteeing your child better health.
Respecter le calendrier vaccinal, c’est.bm: Boloci dafali bɛ den ka kɛnɛya sinsin.

Enregistrement des enfants à l'état civi.en: Civil registration of children from birth and registration of children, girls and boys, in school
Enregistrement des enfants à l'état civi.bm: Denw ka wɔlɔsɛben dilali joona ani den musomanw ni cɛmanw bɛɛ tɔgɔ sɛbɛni lakɔli la (nazara kalan)

Enregistrer la naissance de chaque enfan.en: Registering the birth of every child as soon as he or she is born guarantees that child a legal identity recognized by the State.
Enregistrer la naissance de chaque enfan.bm: Ni wɔlɔsɛben kɛra den la jona o ba to a bɛ lakodɔn jamana den ye.

Sans acte de naissance, un enfant reste.en: Without a birth certificate, a child remains "invisible" in the eyes of the law.
Sans acte de naissance, un enfant reste.bm: Ni wolosɛben tɛ den la a te dɔn jamana den ye.

Filles ou garçons, chaque enfant mérite.en: Girls or boys, every child deserves to learn, enroll all your children in school.
Filles ou garçons, chaque enfant mérite.bm: Den musoma ni cɛma bɛ ni kalan ka kan. Aw ye denw do kalan la.

Promotion de l'allaitement maternel et s.en: Promotion of breastfeeding and especially exclusive breastfeeding up to 6 months of birth
Promotion de l'allaitement maternel et s.bm: Sinji gɛrɛgɛrɛ dili den ma ka daminɛ a sɔrɔ dɔn fo kalo wɔrɔ nafaw sankɔrɔtali

L’allaitement maternel exclusif pendant.en: Exclusive breastfeeding for the first 6 months provides your baby with all the nutrients needed to grow healthy and protects them from childhood diseases such as diarrhea, respiratory infections, and improves infant survival.
L’allaitement maternel exclusif pendant.bm: Sinji gɛrɛgɛrɛ dili denyɛrɛni ma kalo wɔrɔ fɔlɔ kɔnɔ nafaw ka can. A ba to den be balo kaɲɛ wa a be kisi bana juguw ma inafɔ kɔnɔboli ni sɔgɔsɔgɔw.

Le bébé grandit en bonne santé grâce à l.en: The baby grows healthy thanks to exclusive breastfeeding until 6 months.

Prévention et réponse contre les Violenc.en: Preventing and Responding to Gender-Based Violence
Prévention et réponse contre les Violenc.bm: Ka taganli kɛ lajabali sugubɛ man.

Chaque personne mérite d’être protégée..en: Every person deserves to be protected.
Chaque personne mérite d’être protégée..bm: Mɔgɔnifi bɛ kanka kisi lajabali man.

Il est essentiel de créer un environneme.en: It is essential to create a safe and respectful environment for all, including at home, at school and in the community, where no form of violence, physical, verbal or sexual, is tolerated.
Il est essentiel de créer un environneme.bm:
Nikun bɛ ni boyan ni karaman de kanka, ka daminɛ duw kɔnɔ fo kɛnɛma, sigidaw la, kalanyɔrɔw la... 
Lajabali suguw si ma daga (hakili lajabali ni farikolo lajabali), bugɔli, nenili walima dɔgɔyali, bikanli.

Choisir les bons aliments pour chaque re.en: Choosing the right foods for every meal

Privilégiez les produits locaux, de sais.en: Favor local, seasonal products, and minimally processed foods for better nutritional quality to support the local economy and limit salt, sugar, and fat.
Privilégiez les produits locaux, de sais.bm: An ka yiridenw ni an ka sɛnɛ fɛw dunli matarafa, an ka sugaro, koko ani tulu dɔgɔya. O bɛ an kisi banajuguw man.

Signes de danger chez les enfants et les.en: Danger Signs in Children and Pregnant Women
Signes de danger chez les enfants et les.bm: Taamasiɲɛnw jugumanw minnu be se ka kɛ demisɛniw ani muso kɔnɔmanw la

Chez la femme enceinte, reconnaître tôt.en: In pregnant women, early recognition of danger signs such as bleeding, intense abdominal pain, swelling of the face or limbs, severe headaches, vision problems or fever should alert us.
Chez la femme enceinte, reconnaître tôt.bm: Muso kɔnɔma ka taamasiɲɛnw jugumanw inafo jolibonli muso kan, kɔnɔdimi juguman, ɲɛda ni senw funuli, kunkolo dimi jugu, farikalaya ani dibidoli a ɲɛ kɔrɔ kanka muso bila kata n'u ye kɛnɛyasinsin baga fɛ.

Des vomissements persistants, une absenc.en: Persistent vomiting, lack of movement of the baby, and hypertension during pregnancy should alert and encourage immediate attention to a health center.
Des vomissements persistants, une absenc.bm: Fɔnɔ ban bali, den lamaga baliya, tension yɛlɛli kɔnɔmaya kɔnɔ, kanka muso bila kata kɛnɛyasola jona.

Chez le bébé et l’enfant, soyez vigilant.en: In babies and children, be vigilant for high fever, diarrhea, vomiting, refusal to eat or drink, respiratory problems, or any significant change in their behavior.
Chez le bébé et l’enfant, soyez vigilant.bm: Denyɛrɛni ni den tɔw ka farikalaya, kɔnɔbolo, fɔnɔ, dumuni kɛbaliya, ji min baliya, ninnakili degunli, walima u kɛcogo falenni kanka aw bila kata n'u ye kɛnɛyasinsin baga fɛ.

La précocité de l'accès aux soins de san.bm: Furakɛli sɔrɔli joona nafaw bana daminɛ

Dès les premiers signes de maladie, n’at.en: At the first signs of illness, don't wait, go to the health center quickly.
Dès les premiers signes de maladie, n’at.bm: Aw ye ta kɛnɛyasola bana daminɛ. Bana furakɛ ka nɔgɔ a daminɛ ka tɛmɛ n'a juguyara kan wa o bato a te kɔlɔlɔ juguman se a tigi ma.

L'observer le traitement permet d'éviter.en: Observing the treatment helps to avoid complications, and helps to protect individual and collective health.
L'observer le traitement permet d'éviter.bm: Furakɛli dafali bɛ bana juguyali ani bana tagasegi bali wa a bɛ banabagatɔ nin kisi ani ka du bɛ kisi.

Terminer son traitement, c’est se protég.en: Sticking to your treatment avoids complications and relapses, and reduces the risk of drug resistance.
Terminer son traitement, c’est se protég.bm: Aw ye fura ta a ta cogo ani a ta wati la.

La vitamine A est essentielle à la crois.en: Vitamin A is essential for growth, development, and protection against infection.
La vitamine A est essentielle à la crois.bm: Witamini A nafa ka bo den kɔrɔbaya ko ɲuman la.

La supplémentation en vitamine A, notamm.en: Vitamin A supplementation, especially in children aged 6 to 59 months and women in the postnatal period, significantly reduces infant mortality and the severity of diseases such as measles and diarrhoea.
La supplémentation en vitamine A, notamm.bm: Witamini A ba to den fitiniw nin kisi (kalo 6 kata 59). A b'u kisi kɔnɔboli ani rougeole walima suro fiye ma.

Commencez par remercier tous les partici.en:
Start by thanking all participants for their attendance, their involvement, and the efforts they made to achieve the set objectives.
Highlight the progress made and the important decisions made during the meeting.
Then reiterate the importance of carefully recording the actions to be taken and the deadlines set.
Encourage everyone to stay committed to the future and prepare for the next steps.
Finally, don't forget to schedule the next meeting using the scheduling form to automatically receive a reminder.

Informations d'ordre générale.bm: SKS kan ka ɲinnigali minnu kɛ foli kɔfɛ

Est-ce que l'ASC demande s'il y a un mal.en: Does CHW ask members of their community to come to their site for any health problem?
Est-ce que l'ASC demande s'il y a un mal.bm: Yala SKS b'a ɲini a ka sigidala mɔgɔw ka n'a sɛgɛrɛ ni kɛnɛyako gɛlɛya kunbɔra wa?

Est-ce que l’ASC fait un rappel sur le p.en: Does the CHW make a reminder about the service package it offers?
Est-ce que l’ASC fait un rappel sur le p.bm: Yala SKS bɛ hakiligigin kɛ a ka baarakɛta jɔnjɔn kan wa?

Comportement de l'asc face aux membres d.en: Behavior of asc in the face of members of his community at his site
Comportement de l'asc face aux membres d.bm: SKS kɛwale ka ɲɛsin gwa mɔgɔw ma

Est ce que l’ASC agit avec respect et co.en: Does the CHW act respectfully and courteously with the members of the household?
Est ce que l’ASC agit avec respect et co.bm: Yala SKS bꜫ baara kꜫ n'a ka sigida mɔgɔw ye ni boɲan ni majigin ye wa?

Est-ce que l’ASC donne le temps aux memb.en: Does CHW allow time for household members to express their health needs with an active listening approach?
Est-ce que l’ASC donne le temps aux memb.bm: Yala SKS b'a to a ka sigida mɔgɔw k'u ka kɛnɛyako gɛlɛyaw ɲꜫfo ka ɲꜫ ni lamꜫko ɲuman ye wa?

Est-ce qu’il y’a un membre du ménage mal.en: Is there a member of the sick household assessed by the CHW?
Est-ce qu’il y’a un membre du ménage mal.bm: Yala SKS ye dɔ ka bana kiimꜫli kꜫ e ɲꜫna wa?

Veuillez cliquer sur le plus en dessous.en: Please click on the plus below to mark the information for the first patient
Veuillez cliquer sur le plus en dessous.bm: I bolo digui ni kan walasa k'a Banabagatɔ ka farigan kiimꜫli kꜫ

Est-ce que l’ASC a posé de bonnes questi.en: Has the CHW posed good open questions in seeking information for better management and / or guidance of this patient?
Est-ce que l’ASC a posé de bonnes questi.bm: Yala SKS ye ɲinnigali dayꜫlꜫlen ɲumanw kꜫ walasa ka kunnafoninw sɔrɔ bana furakꜫ ko ɲuman kan ani/walima banabagatɔ in bilasira ko ɲuman?

Est-ce que l’ASC lit les signes de dange.en: Does the CHW read the danger signs one by one and look for them?
Est-ce que l’ASC lit les signes de dange.bm: Yala SKS bꜫ taamasiyꜫn jugumanw kalan kelen kelen ani ku ɲinni banabagatɔ la wa?

Est-ce que l’ASC renseigne au fur et à m.en: Does the ASC provide information as the application progresses during the course of care?
Est-ce que l’ASC renseigne au fur et à m.bm: Yala SKS be kunnafoniso lafa telefɔni kɔnɔ a senfɛ furakɛli waati kɔnɔ wa?

Est-ce que l'ASC a bien placé le thermom.en: Has the CHW placed the thermometer correctly?
Est-ce que l'ASC a bien placé le thermom.bm: Yala SKS ye farikalayatalan don cogo ɲɛ wa? (Ja lajɛ kaɲɛ sani'i ka jaabi di)

Est-ce que l’ASC a pris le temps nécessa.en: Did the CHW take the necessary time before reading the temperature?
Est-ce que l’ASC a pris le temps nécessa.bm: Yala SKS ye waati bɛnnen ta (sanga kelen ɲɔgɔn sanni a ka farikalaya hakɛ kalan wa?

Est-ce qu’il y’a une indication pour réa.en: Is there any indication for achieving the malaria RDT?
Est-ce qu’il y’a une indication pour réa.bm: Yala taamasiɲɛn dɔw bɛyen min b'a to sumaya sɛgɛsɛgɛli (TDR) bɛ kɛ wa?

Est ce que l’ASC a réalisé un TDR paludi.en: Did the CHW perform a malaria RDT during this visit?
Est ce que l’ASC a réalisé un TDR paludi.bm: Yala SKS ye sumaya sɛgɛsɛgɛli (TDR) kɛ yala senfɛ wa?

Est-ce que l’ASC réunit tout le kit dont.en: Does the CHW have all the kit they need for TDR?
Est-ce que l’ASC réunit tout le kit dont.bm: Yala SKS y'a ka sɛgɛsɛgɛli minɛnw bɛ bila'a bolokɔrɔ wa TDR kɛli kawa?

Est-ce que l’ASC a vérifié la date de pé.en: Did the CHW check the expiry date on the back of the cassette bag? [Look closely at the picture before answering the question]
Est-ce que l’ASC a vérifié la date de pé.bm: Yala SKS ye TDR ɲumanya kuntaala sɛgɛsɛgɛ wa a forokokan?

Est-ce qu'un autre TDR a été administré.en: Has another RDT been administered for this patient?
Est-ce qu'un autre TDR a été administré.bm: Yala TDR wɛrɛ kɛra banabagatɔla in la wa?

Est-ce que l’ASC a désinfecté ses mains.en: Did the CHW disinfect his hands before the completion of the TDR?
Est-ce que l’ASC a désinfecté ses mains.bm: Yala SKS y'a tɛgɛw saniya yanni a bɛ TDR kɛ wa?

Est-ce que l’ASC a enfilé correctement u.en: Did the CHW correctly put on a pair of gloves before stinging the patient?
Est-ce que l’ASC a enfilé correctement u.bm: Yala SKS ye ganw don kaɲɛ sann'a ka banabagatɔ sɔgɔ wa?

Est-ce que l’ASC a marqué les informatio.en: Did the ASC mark the information on the tape (name and surname of patient, date and time of completion) before proceeding to the test?
Est-ce que l’ASC a marqué les informatio.bm: Yala SKS ye kunnafoniw sɛbɛn tɛsi (cassette) kan wa? (banabagatɔ tɔgɔ n'a jamun, sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ don n'a waati) sanni sɛgɛsɛgɛli ka kɛ?

Est-ce que l’ASC a désinfecté correcteme.en: Did the CHW properly disinfect the patient's finger before pricking it?
Est-ce que l’ASC a désinfecté correcteme.bm: Yala SKS ye banabagatɔ tɛgɛ saniya ka ɲɛ sann'a k'a sɔgɔ wa?

Quelle quantité de sang l’ASC a recueill.en: How much blood did the ASC collect and put in the cassette?
Quelle quantité de sang l’ASC a recueill.bm: SKS ye joli hakɛ jumɛn minnɛ kakɛ tɛsi kɔlɔn kɔnɔn?

Combien de gouttes de solvant l’ASC a mi.en: How many drops of solvent did the ASC put to migrate the blood (Mark the number of drops)?[Look closely at the picture before answering the question]
Combien de gouttes de solvant l’ASC a mi.bm: Yala SKS ye sɔlivan ji toni ko joli kɛ walasa ka joli la taa (toninko hakɛ sɛbɛn)[Ja ni lajɛ kaɲɛ yann'i ka jaabi di]

Estimation du temps pour la lecture du r.en: Estimated time for reading the RDT result:

Veuillez utiliser votre téléphone (le ch.en: Please use your phone (the stopwatch or the watch) for the time (en minute)
Veuillez utiliser votre téléphone (le ch.bm: A ɲininendo i fɛ i ki ka telefɔni lɛrɛ jaateminɛ walasa k'a don SKS joli jaate

Marquez le temps (en minutes) que l’ASC.en: Mark the time (in minutes) that the ASC took before reading the TDR (This is the time between adding the solvent and reading the result)
Marquez le temps (en minutes) que l’ASC.bm: SKS ka waati kɛlen sɛbɛn sann'a ka TDR jaabi kalan (miniti la). Waati bɛ talikɛ sɔlivan ji kɛli ka se jaabi kalan ni ma

Est-ce que l’ASC a arrangé les aiguilles.en: Did the ASC arrange the needles in the safety box after use?
Est-ce que l’ASC a arrangé les aiguilles.bm: Yala SKS ye biɲɛw lasago buwati kɔnɔ sɔgɔli kɔfɛ wa?

Quel est le résultat du TDR paludisme re.en: What is the result of the malaria TDR retained by the CHW?
Quel est le résultat du TDR paludisme re.bm: SKS ye jaabi jumɛn di TDR kan?

Quel est le résultat du TDR paludisme se.en: What is the result of TDR malaria according to your interpretation?
Quel est le résultat du TDR paludisme se.bm: Yala TDR jaabi ye jumɛn ye e yɛrɛ ka jateminɛ la?

Quelle est la conduite à tenir de l’ASC.en: What is the response of the ASC to the result of the TDR?
Quelle est la conduite à tenir de l’ASC.bm: SKS ka kɛta kɛra jumɛn ye ka ɲɛsin TDR jaabi ma?

Est-ce que la fréquence respiratoire a é.en: Has the respiratory rate been counted by the ASC?
Est-ce que la fréquence respiratoire a é.bm: Yala SKS ye ninnakili tani ka segin jate wa?

Quelle est la fréquence respiratoire tro.en: What is the respiratory rate found by the ASC (In cycle / min)?
Quelle est la fréquence respiratoire tro.bm: Ninakili tani ka segin bɛnna joli ma? (Miniti jate kɔnɔ)

Quelle est la fréquence respiratoire que.en: What is the respiratory rate you found yourself (in cycle / min)?
Quelle est la fréquence respiratoire que.bm: Yala e yɛrɛ ye ninnakili tani ka segin joli jate? (Miniti jate kɔnɔ)

Est-ce que le périmètre branchial est me.en: Is mid-upper arm circumference measured by ASC [Valid only for children 6 months to 59 months]?[Look closely at the picture before answering the question]
Est-ce que le périmètre branchial est me.bm: Yala SKS ye bolokanlamini suma wa? (Ja ni lajɛ kaɲɛ yann'i ka jaabi di (Nin bɛ tali kɛ kalo wɔrɔ (6) kata kalo biduru ni kɔnɔtɔ n'a(59))

En cas de référence est ce que l’ASC dis.en: In case of referral, is the ASC discussing with family members to help the patient reach the CSCOM?
En cas de référence est ce que l’ASC dis.bm: Nin tali kan ka kɛ CSCOM la, yala SKS bɛ kumaɲɔgɔnɲa kɛ banabagatɔ sɔmɔgɔw fɛ walasa k'u dɛmɛ banabagatɔ ka se CSCOM la wa?

Vous avez fini de remplir le formulaire.en: You have completed the Patient Assessment Observation Form. If you want to do another patient assessment observation, be sure to click on the plus below.
Vous avez fini de remplir le formulaire.bm: Ni ye ni banabagatɔw ka kiimɛli sɛben baanen ye, Yala i be fɛ ka banabagatɔw wɛrɛ ka kiimɛli kɛ wa?

Est-ce que l’ASC dispose de tous les int.en: Verify that the CHW has all the inputs
Est-ce que l’ASC dispose de tous les int.bm: A jateminɛ nin SKS ka baarakɛfɛn bɛɛ b'a bolo

Coton et/ou paquets de papier mouchoir.en: Cotton and/or packets of tissue paper

Est-ce que les intrants sont bien gardés.en: Are the inputs well guarded by the CHW?
Est-ce que les intrants sont bien gardés.bm: Yala baarakɛfɛnw minɛko kaɲi SKS bolo wa (Furaforokow, furaw ɲɛw, furakisɛw cogoya, furabaraw n'u datugulanw bɛɛ kaɲi wa)

Est-ce que l’ASC remplit correctement le.en: Does the ASC correctly fill the supports (telephones, other supports ...)?
Est-ce que l’ASC remplit correctement le.bm: Yala SKS bɛ kunnafoni talanw lafa u cogo la wa (Telefoni,kunnafoni talan wɛrɛw)?

Est-ce que les supports sont biens tenus.en: Are the supports well maintained by the CHW?
Est-ce que les supports sont biens tenus.bm: Yala kunnafoni talanw minɛcogo kaɲi SKS bolo wa (sɛbɛnw faralen do wa, A sɛbɛnniw kalan kadi wa? Telefɔni lasagolen do kaɲɛ wa...)?

Informer l’ASC que la recherche active e.bm: SKS ladɔnniya ko banabagatɔw ɲinnili gwa ni gwa ye an ka tabolo, walasa ka den saya ni den bamuso saya dɔgɔya ani k'a se ka banabagatɔw sɔrɔ baana daminɛ.
Informer l’ASC que la recherche active e.en: Inform the CHW that active research is one of the best approaches to dramatically reduce mortality and morbidity because it allows patients to be traced quickly before their illnesses get worse.

Comportement face aux membres du ménage.en: Behavior in front of household members
Comportement face aux membres du ménage.bm: SKS kɛwale ka ɲɛsin gwa mɔgɔw ma

Félicitez et encouragez l’ASC pour sa bo.en: Praise and encourage the CHW for good behavior with household members to keep up well with members of their community. Remind him that this is the key to the success of everything we do.
Félicitez et encouragez l’ASC pour sa bo.bm: SKS fo ani ka dusu don a la a ka kɛwale ɲumanw la ka ɲɛsi a ka gwa mɔgɔw ma. A hakili jigi k'o y'an ka ka ɲɛtaa kow bɛɛ gundo ye.

Informer l’ASC que ce tenir bien avec le.en: Informing the CHW that keeping it well with members of its community is key to the success of everything we do. Community satisfaction is one of our most desired goals.
Informer l’ASC que ce tenir bien avec le.bm: SKS ladɔnniya ko kɛwale ɲumanw ka ɲɛsin sigida mɔgɔw ma y'an ka ɲɛtaa gundo ye. Sigidalamɔgɔw sago sɔrɔli y'an ka kuntilenna ɲininta ba dɔw ye.

Évaluation du patient 1.bm: Sɛbɛn kɔnɔkow walawalalen banabagatɔ ka farigan kiimꜫli jateminꜫli 1

Indication de réalisation de TDR paludis.en: Indication of achievement of malaria TDRs

Demander à l’ASC ses motivations à faire.en: Ask the ASC about their motivations for doing the malaria RDT for this patient who apparently presented no indications to perform the malaria RDT.
Demander à l’ASC ses motivations à faire.bm:
SKS ɲinnika kun jumɛn na a bafɛ ka sumaya sɛgɛsɛgɛli kɛ ni banabagatɔ la ka sɔrɔ sumaya tamasiɲɛ tala. 
SKS hakilijigin TDR kɛ kunw naa.
Ɲɛfɔli kɛ kɔsɛbɛ aw ka kuma ɲɔgɔya wati

Rappelez à l’ASC les indications de réal.en: Remind the ASC of the indications for performing TDR malaria ideally at the individual meeting.
Rappelez à l’ASC les indications de réal.bm: SKS hakilijigin bilasirali la TDR kɛcogo ɲuman kan n'i kelen n'a kelen do aw ka kuma ɲɔgɔya wati

Informez l’ASC que la quantité de sang à.en: Inform the ASC that the amount of blood to be used (a pipette) is sufficient to fully interpret the TDR result. On the contrary, a surplus can lead to a false diagnosis.
Informez l’ASC que la quantité de sang à.bm: A ɲɛfo SKS ye ko joli taa ta hakɛ (kutunni ɲɛ kelen bɛ bɔli kɛ walasa ka TDR jaabi ɲɛfɔ). Ni joli hakɛ ma ɲɛ o bɛ se ka yelema do TDR jaabi la.

Informez l’ASC que quatre (4) gouttes de.en: Inform the ASC that four (4) drops of solvent is more than enough to migrate the blood so that the result can be read.
Informez l’ASC que quatre (4) gouttes de.bm: A fɔ SKS ye ko Sɔliwanji tonni ko naani (4) bɛ kɛ walasa ka se ka joli lata ani ka se ka ka jaabi kalan.

Temps avant la lecture du TDR paludisme.en: Time before reading the malaria RDT
Temps avant la lecture du TDR paludisme.bm: Sanga, ka ɲɛsin TDR kalanni ma

Informer l’ASC qu’observer les 15 mn ava.en: Informing the CSA to observe the 15 minutes before reading the result of the TDR Malaria is essential because the non respect of this delay can lead to errors of interpretation.
Informer l’ASC qu’observer les 15 mn ava.bm: A fɔ SKS ye ko miniti tan ni duru (15) tali jaabi kalanni la nafa ka bon kosɛbɛ, bawo o sanga boɲabaliya bɛ se ka fiɲɛ do bila jaabi ɲɛfoli la.

Résultat du TDR paludisme du superviseur.en: Outcome of the CHT supervisor's malaria RDT

Sipɛriwisɛri ka ka sumaya TDR jaabi ye: {r_super_tdr_result_label_fr_1}

Utilisez une approche à ne pas frustrer.en: Use an approach not to frustrate the CSA to correct the interpretation of the CSA RDT result. Identify the possible reasons that led to this misinterpretation and return to this point at the individual meeting.
Utilisez une approche à ne pas frustrer.bm: Ɲɛfɔli kɛ SKS ye ka sɔrɔ a ma tɔrɔ kun munnu be sa ka to TDR jaabi te ɲɛn, aw ka hakilina falen- falen waati.

Satisfaisant \nLors de la rencontre indi.en:
Satisfactory 
During the individual meeting, the CHW supervisor must be respectfully congratulated for having properly greeted and explained the purpose of the visit. It is important to encourage them to maintain this good practice, because it builds trust and promotes harmonious collaboration with CHWs.

Pas satisfaisant \nLors de la réunion in.en:
Not satisfactory 
During the individual meeting, it is important to remind the supervisor that supervision always begins with a respectful greeting and a clear explanation of the purpose of the visit. This introductory moment is essential to create a climate of trust and encourage good collaboration with the community.

Not satisfactory 
During the individual meeting, it is essential to remind the supervisor that he must systematically check whether households know the CHW assigned to their area, know where to find him and have his contact details.
In the event of lack of knowledge, the supervisor must react proactively: share the necessary information (name, place of residence, telephone number) and ensure that the household knows how to contact the CHW if necessary.
This approach helps to strengthen the accessibility of care and the confidence of households in the community health system.

Satisfaisant \nLors de la réunion indivi.en:
Satisfactory 
During the individual meeting, praise the supervisor for verifying the household's knowledge of CSA, and for sharing necessary information when required.
This good practice is essential to guarantee household accessibility to community health services. It helps to strengthen the bond between CHWs and families.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for verifying the regularity of visits and the availability of ASC services. This approach helps ensure the quality of care and strengthen household confidence.

Pas satisfaisant \nRappelez au supervise.en:
Not satisfactory 
Remind the supervisor that he must systematically verify the ASC's visits and services, even in the absence of a complaint. In case of doubt or service not provided, he must clarify expectations with the household

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Praise the supervisor for checking the CHW's behavior and responding appropriately to any concerns expressed by the household. This attention strengthens the quality of relationships and trust in community care.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that he must assess the CHW’s respect and attentiveness to households. In case of doubt or complaint, he must react with kindness and remind the ASC of the importance of these values ​​for good community support.

Satisfaisant \nFélicitez le superviseur.en:
Satisfactory 
Congratulate the supervisor for verifying the services received by the household and the communication actions carried out by the CHW. In the event of a missing or misunderstood service, its reaction made it possible to restore good information

Pas satisfaisant \nRappelez au supervise.en:
Not satisfactory 
Remind the supervisor of the importance of verifying the services actually provided and the messages transmitted by the ASC. In case of omission or confusion, he must provide clarifications and reinforce the information to the household

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for identifying pregnant women in the household, checking the CHW's dialogue on ANC, malaria prevention (SP, mosquito net) and consultation of the notebook. Its vigilance helps to improve pregnancy monitoring

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that he must systematically request the presence of one or more pregnant women, confirm the monitoring carried out by the CHW (including doses of SP), and react to any observed failure. These steps are essential to prevent pregnancy-related complications.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Praise the supervisor for verifying whether payments have been made by the household, and for responding appropriately if payments are not compliant. This vigilance is essential to guarantee equitable and free access to community care.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor to always inquire about formal or informal payments made by households. In the event of payment not complying with protocols, it must react immediately to report the incident and protect the rights of users.

Satisfaisant \nFélicitez le superviseur.en:
Satisfactory 
Praise the supervisor for asking the household's opinion on CHW services, understanding the reasons for an average or poor rating, and accurately noting suggestions without influencing responses. This good practice strengthens the quality of care and community trust.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor of the importance of giving households a voice to evaluate the services received, especially in the event of an average or poor rating. He must understand the reasons, collect the suggestions, and note them faithfully without influencing. This feedback is essential to improve services and better meet the needs of the community.

Satisfaisant \nFélicitez le superviseur.en:
Satisfactory 
Congratulate the supervisor for checking if the household knows about the MUSO NGO, CHW services and the area CHW. He also explained these services well and made the household aware of the role of CHWs. This approach strengthens the visibility of the program and the engagement of families. Encourage him to continue this.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor of the importance of checking if the household knows about the MUSO NGO, the CHW services and their role. He must clearly explain these services before asking his questions, and take advantage of the exchange to raise awareness of the importance of ASC in the community. This strengthens household confidence and support.

Satisfaisant \nFélicitez le superviseur.en:
Satisfactory 
Praise the supervisor for viewing and using the intuitive messages to adapt their communication with the household in a clear and respectful manner. This improves the quality of exchanges and promotes more human and effective supervision.

Pas satisfaisant \nRappelez au supervise.en:
Not satisfactory 
Remind the supervisor of the importance of reading the intuitive messages generated in the form. These messages are useful benchmarks for structuring communication that is adapted, respectful and centered on the needs of the household. Not using them limits the impact of supervision

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory 
 Congratulate the supervisor for observing that the CHW started the exchange with respect and established a climate of listening. He noted a good active listening posture: eye contact, open posture, reformulation, without unnecessary interruption. Encourage him to continue this kind observation, which is essential to strengthen the relationship with the households.

Pas satisfaisant\n Rappelez au supervise.en:
Not satisfactory
 Remind the supervisor to check if the CHW begins the interview with respect and establishes a climate of listening. He must observe active listening: gaze, posture, reformulation, without interruption. These key points build household confidence.

Satisfaisant\n Félicitez le superviseur.en:
Satisfactory 
 Praise the supervisor for observing the CHW's assessment and reacting correctly in the event of an error or incomplete assessment. This monitoring strengthens the quality of care.

Pas satisfaisant\n Rappelez au supervise.en:
Not satisfactory
 Remind the supervisor that he must observe the assessment made by the CHW and intervene if it is incomplete or incorrect. This is essential to guarantee quality care.

Satisfaisant\n Félicitez le superviseur.en:
Satisfactory 
 Congratulate the supervisor for checking the available inputs one by one, monitoring their conservation, and reminding them of good practices if necessary. This guarantees the quality and safety of care.

Pas satisfaisant\n Rappelez au supervise.en:
Not satisfactory
 Remind the supervisor that he must check each input, ensure that they are properly preserved, and remind people of the practices to follow if necessary. These actions are essential to avoid breakage or damage.

Satisfaisant\n Félicitez le superviseur.en:
Satisfactory 
 Congratulate the supervisor for having checked the correct use of the materials (telephone, notebooks, cards, etc.), their general condition, and for having given recommendations if necessary. This contributes to reliable and well-tracked documentation.

Pas satisfaisant\n Rappelez au supervise.en:
Not satisfactory
 Remind the supervisor that he must check the quality of the media used by the ASC (readability, condition, protection, etc.) and give advice if necessary. Well-maintained supports are essential for good traceability of care.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for inviting the CHW to identify their strengths and areas for improvement, by listening actively and without judgment. This caring posture promotes the commitment of the ASC and strengthens the relationship of trust. Encourage him to continue like this

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor of the importance of asking the CHW about their strengths and what they think needs improvement. Listening without judgment values ​​the ASC and encourages their involvement in their own development, while strengthening the relationship of trust.

Satisfaisant \nFélicitez le superviseur.en:
Satisfactory 
Congratulate the supervisor for starting with observations from previous visits, highlighting the ASC's strengths and presenting areas for improvement as areas for progress. This approach reinforces positive and motivating supervision. Encourage him to continue this.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that a good supervisory closure includes feedback on previous visits, highlighting strengths, and sympathetic formulation of areas for improvement. This strengthens the motivation of the ASC and creates a climate of trust favorable to its progress.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for allowing the CHW to express their difficulties (inputs, tools, community) and for actively listening, without interruption or judgment. This posture builds confidence and effectively supports the ASC. Encourage him to continue like this

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor of the importance of creating a space for expression so that the CHW can share their difficulties. Attentive listening, without interruption or judgment, allows you to better understand the needs of the field, strengthen trust and support the motivation of the ASC.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Praise the supervisor for proposing concrete solutions to the CHW's difficulties and discussing their feasibility. This collaborative approach strengthens engagement and shows the ASC that it is truly being listened to. Encourage him to continue this.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that he must propose concrete solutions to the difficulties raised by the ASC, and discuss them with him to verify their feasibility. This dialogue strengthens collaboration and shows the ASC that it is supported in its work.

Satisfaisant \nFélicitez le superviseur.en:
Satisfactory 
Praise the supervisor for proposing concrete solutions to the CHW's difficulties and discussing their feasibility. This collaborative approach strengthens engagement and shows the ASC that it is truly being listened to. Encourage him to continue this.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for proposing possible solutions to difficulties not resolved at the time, and planning for follow-up or deferred action. Its involvement of the ASC in the search for solutions shows participatory and long-term oriented supervision. Encourage him to continue this.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that in the event of a problem not resolved immediately, he must propose avenues or deferred actions, while involving the ASC in the reflection. This participatory approach strengthens commitment and shows the ASC that it is listened to and sustainably supported.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Praise the supervisor for checking for all CHWs and using a list to record them. This reinforces rigor and fairness in supervision.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that it is essential to verify the presence of each ASC and to use a dedicated list. This monitoring is key for effective management of supervision.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for presenting and discussing the agenda with the CHWs, and for validating or adjusting its content with their agreement. This promotes involvement and clarity from the start of the meeting

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that he must always present the agenda at the start of the meeting and validate it with the CHWs. This is a key step in structuring discussions and encouraging participation.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for providing clear feedback on common errors from past supervisions and encouraging CHWs to ask questions. Its constructive posture helps to correct practices and strengthen skills

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that feedback on past supervision is essential to correct recurring errors. It must also encourage questions and propose concrete avenues for improvement.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for leading a capacity building session that was targeted, participatory and related to the difficulties observed. This approach improves the skills and commitment of CHWs.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that he must lead a targeted and participatory reinforcement session during each supervision. This makes it possible to correct errors and strengthen the skills of CHWs in a concrete way.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for using the data from the CHT or dashboard to provide feedback on the distribution of medicines, and for recalling good practices for managing inputs. This reinforces the quality of monitoring and rigor in the use of resources.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that it is essential to use available data to analyze medication distribution and correct errors. It must also recall input management practices to guarantee safety and compliance.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for presenting their monthly plan with specific dates and times, and for using the app to organize visits with confirmation from CHWs. This promotes structured and effective supervision.

Pas satisfaisant \nRappelez au supervise.en:
Not satisfactory 
Remind the supervisor that they must share their supervision plan with CHWs in advance and use the app to organize and track visits. This strengthens coordination and work efficiency.

Difficultés rencontrés par les ASC et pr.en: Difficulties encountered by ASCs and proposed solutions

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for opening a space for discussion, actively listening to the CHWs, noting their difficulties, and proposing concrete solutions. This posture strengthens confidence and work efficiency.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that it is not enough to open the floor: he must also listen actively, note the problems expressed, and propose concrete solutions. Without this, the exchange loses its impact and does not help to improve working conditions.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for checking the synchronization of each ASC's phones. This regular monitoring ensures the transmission of data on time and the proper functioning of digital tools.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that he must systematically check that each ASC has correctly synchronized his phone. Even if the verification is carried out, it must ensure that the synchronization is effective to guarantee the reporting of data.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez le superviseur p.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate the supervisor for setting the date for the next meeting and thank the CHWs for their commitment. A good closing enhances their participation and strengthens collective motivation.

Pas satisfaisant\nRappelez au superviseu.en:
Not satisfactory
Remind the supervisor that he or she should always close the meeting by thanking the CHWs and clearly setting the date for the next one. This promotes continuity and team involvement.

Merci pour tous les efforts consentis po.en: Thank you for all your efforts in caring for us. Indeed, Muso no longer provides care at the health center level for other care and services apart from those related to pregnancy, childbirth, post-delivery follow-up and family planning. We are aware that this can be a challenge for you, and we hope that this potential barrier will be lifted as soon as possible.
Merci pour tous les efforts consentis po.bm: Aw ni ce aw yere ye. Muso tɛ ka bana walima banabagatɔ bɛ furakɛ bilen CSCOM la. An ka mɔgɔ furakɛtaw ye den minu si ma san duru bɔ, muso kɔnɔmanw, jiginiw, jibatɔw ka jigini kɔfɛ lajɛliw ani bange furancɛ janɲali fɛrɛw. An ba dɔn ka ma nɔgɔ n'ga an ka laɲini ye ka fura sɔrɔ ni gɛlɛyala jona.

Vous devriez prendre toutes les disposit.en:
You should make all necessary arrangements to facilitate access to the CSA by the community. Guide the person to know where the CSA lives and to share with him his number and your telephone number.
Inform the person that, in addition to the CSA's routine home visits, they may request the services of the CSA at home.
Vous devriez prendre toutes les disposit.bm: kan ka fɛɛrɛw sigi sen kan walasa ka SKS ka baaraw nɔgɔya sigida kɔnɔ. SKS ka so yɔrɔ yira Sigida mɔgɔw la, a ka telefoni nimɔrɔ a ni yɛrɛ ka nimɔro d'u ma. A ɲɛf' u ye ku bɛ se ka SKS sɔrɔ a ka so n'u mago b'ala.

Informer la personne qu’en plus des visi.en: Inform the person that in addition to routine home visits by the CHW, they may request the services of the CSA at home.
Informer la personne qu’en plus des visi.bm: Ɲɛfɔlikɛ sigida mɔgɔw ye k'u bɛ se ka SKS sɔrɔ a ka so n'u mago b'ala.

Visite du ménage.bm: Yala Yala ka do gaw kɔnɔ

Informez la personne que son ménage doit.en: Inform the person that their household must receive at least 2 VAD per month from the CSA in charge of their area and that you will discuss with them and make all necessary arrangements for this purpose.
Informez la personne que son ménage doit.bm: Ɲɛfɔlikɛ, ko SKS kan ka n'u ka du kɔnɔ a dɔgɔyalen siyɛn fila (2) kalo la ani k'aw bɛ na fɛɛrɛw sigi sen kan o kɛcogo ɲuman kan.

Informer l’ASC de se tenir bien avec les.en: Inform the CSA that it fits well with members of its community as this is the key to the success of all we do. Community satisfaction is one of our most desired goals.
Informer l’ASC de se tenir bien avec les.bm: SKS ladɔnniya ko kɛwale ɲumanw ka ɲɛsin sigida mɔgɔw ma y'an ka ɲɛtaa gundo ye. Sigidalamɔgɔw sago sɔrɔli y'an ka kuntilenna ɲininta ba dɔw ye.

Informez les membres du ménage que, l’AS.en: Inform household members that after initiating treatment at home, the CHW must be followed for a follow-up of three (3) to four (4) days from the next day to learn about the patient's condition . Tell household members to share their availability with the CSA.
Informez les membres du ménage que, l’AS.bm: Ɲɛfɔlikɛ ga mɔgɔw ye, ko SKS wajibiyalen don ka na banabagatɔ lajɛ wa siɲɛn 3 walima 4 sokɔno furakɛli don kɔfɛ, walasa ka banabagatɔ kɔlɔsi bana taabolo kan. U k'u sɔrɔ waati fɔ SKS ye.

Remonter l'information au responsable de.bm: Aw ye ni kunafoni nunnu lase aw ka ɲɛmɔgɔ ma walasa a ka lase a se yɔrɔ la.

Informez les membres du ménage que, l’AS.en: Inform the household members that the CHW after referring or escorting a patient to the CSCOM should be referred for a follow-up of three (3) days from the next day to reassure themselves not only that the patient has received the care or be acquired of his state of health if he received the care. Tell household members to share their availability with the CSA.
Informez les membres du ménage que, l’AS.bm: Ɲɛfɔlikɛ Sigida mɔgɔ ye,ko SKS wajibiyalen don ka na banabagatɔ lajɛ siɲɛn saba (3) CSCOM la furakɛli don kɔfɛ , walasa ka banabagatɔ kɔlɔsi bana taabolo kan ani n'o ya sɔrɔ banabagatɔ ye furakɛli sɔrɔ. U k'u sɔrɔ waati fɔ SKS ye.

Discutez avec la personne afin de savoir.en: Discuss with the person to know his motivations for his choice. Reassure the person and say that one of our key objectives is their satisfaction and that we will take the necessary steps to correct this situation. Raise this very important point in the individual meeting with the CSA.
Discutez avec la personne afin de savoir.bm:
Kumaɲɔngɔnya kɛ ni mɔgɔ koloma ye walasa k'a hakilina don. A ɲɛfo a ye k'u wasali ye anw kukilinna dɔ ye walasa k'a hakili sigi ani k'anw bɛ fɛɛrɛ bɛ sigi sen kan walasa k'o kɛ kaɲɛ.

Hakilina falen falen waati i ni SKS cɛ, a hakili jigin kɔsɛbɛ ni yɔrɔ kan sabula a nafa ka bon.

Informez la personne que sa zone de rési.en:
Inform the person that their area of ​​residence is covered by a CHW. Talk to him about the services an ASC offers.
Explain where the CSA lives and share your phone number and the CSA number with the person and may request last-resort services if needed.
Informez la personne que sa zone de rési.bm: Ɲɛfɔlikɛ mɔgɔ koloman ye, ko SKS b'u ka sigida la. SKS ka baarakɛtaw fɔ a ye. SKS ka so yɔrɔ yira a la, SKS ka telefɔni nimɔrɔ ni i yɛrɛ ka telefɔni nimɔrɔ d'u ma. A ɲɛf'u ye ku bɛ se ka SKS sɔrɔ so n'u mago b'ala.

Féliciter la/les femme(s) qui ont suivi.en:
Praise the woman for following up on ANC and her malaria prevention treatment, as this is the most effective way to protect her and her baby from this disease.
During your individual meeting, you can congratulate the ASC for the well-done follow-up of this lady
Féliciter la/les femme(s) qui ont suivi.bm:
Muso kɔnɔma fo kɔsɛbɛ a ka pesili ni a ka SP matarafali la, sabula o de ye muso ni den lakanani fɛɛrɛ ɲumanba ye sumaya bana kɛlɛli la.
Aw ka hakilina falen falen waati, i bɛ se ka foli lase SKS ma a ka ni Muso kɔnɔma ka kɔlɔsili kɛ cogo ɲuman na.

Expliquez à la femme le risque de grosse.en: Explain to the woman the risk of unwanted pregnancy if you have unprotected sex and let her know that she can see you or go to the health centre if you have any questions or to start FP.
Expliquez à la femme le risque de grosse.bm:
Kunnafoniw di muso ma kɔnɔmaya balalenw kɔlɔlɔw kan.

A fɔ muso ye k'a bese kana i fɛ walima kata CSCOM la n'a mago jora ila kɛrɛkɛrɛlen ya la n'a mago sera bange furancɛ janŋali fɛrɛw (PF) ma tuguni.

Informez la femme que le renouvellement.en: Inform the woman that the Injectable is scheduled to be renewed in 75 days and that you will need to see her again on that date.
Informez la femme que le renouvellement.bm: A fɔ muso ye k'a ka Pikirini fɛrɛ kan ka lakuraya ni kalo saba dafara (kɛrɛkɛrɛlenyala tile 75 kɔnɔ). A bese kana i ka so i ka lakuraya walima i yɛrɛ bese kata kɛ a ka so.

Informez la femme que le renouvellement.en: Inform the woman that the Sayana Press is due to be renewed in 75 days and that you will have to see each other again on that date.
Informez la femme que le renouvellement.bm: A fɔ muso ye k'a ka Sayana fɛrɛ kan ka lakuraya ni kalo saba dafara (kɛrɛkɛrɛlenyala tile 75 kɔnɔ). A bese kana i ka so i ka lakuraya walima i yɛrɛ bese kata kɛ a ka so.

Informez la femme qu’un préservatif neuf.en: Inform the woman that a new condom should be used every time you have sex, that it should be put on before sexual contact and discarded after use.
Informez la femme qu’un préservatif neuf.bm: A fɔ muso ye ko Manani kura kanka do kafoɲɔgɔya kelen kelen bɛ la, wa a kanka a fili n'a kilala yɔrɔ ɲuman na.

Informez la femme qu’elle doit prendre s.en: Inform the woman that she must take her estrogen-progestogen pill every day at the same time and that she will contact you if she forgets or is more than 3 hours late.
Informez la femme qu’elle doit prendre s.bm: A ŋɛfɔ muso ye k'a kanka Furakisɛni ta don ko don waati kelen na. N'a hakili bɔra n'a bɛ lɛri saba (3heures) ŋɔgɔ bɔ a ka fɔ i ye, i ba bilasira a ta cogo la

Informez la femme qu’elle doit prendre s.en: Inform the woman that she must take her progestin-only pill daily without interruption and that she will contact you if she forgets more than 2 days.
Informez la femme qu’elle doit prendre s.bm: A ŋɛfɔ muso ye k'a kanka Furakisɛni ta don ko don waati kelen na. N'a hakili bɔra ka ta n'a bɛ tile fila (2jours) bɔ a ka fɔ i ye, i ba bilasira a ta cogo la

Informez la femme que le collier du cycl.en: Inform the woman that the cycle collar helps her spot her fertile days and that she should avoid intercourse or use a condom during these days.
Informez la femme que le collier du cycl.bm: A ŋɛfɔ muso ye k'o Kɔnɔkisɛni b'a to a be garisigɛ sɔrɔli teliman donw dɔn, o b'a to Cɛ bɛ Manani dɔn o donw la.

Informez la femme que la méthode MAMA n’.en: Inform the woman that the MAMA method is only effective if the baby is less than 6 months old, she is breastfeeding exclusively and her period has not returned.
Informez la femme que la méthode MAMA n’.bm: A ŋɛfɔ muso ye k'o PF fɛrɛ MAMA min ye Sinji gɛrɛgɛrɛ dili ye den ma, nafa dan ye kalo wɔrɔ(6) ye wa o ka sɔrɔ muso ka lada mana.

The purpose of cord care is to prevent infection, dry the cord and properly heal the insertion area
Keep the newborn's location warm and free from drafts day and night.
Dress the baby in dry clothes (the newborn needs at least 1-2 more layers of clothing than an adult).
Cover the baby's head with a cloth or hat.
Avoid clothes and blankets that are too tight.
Place the newborn in a bed with the mother so that he or she is warm and breastfed. Hold the newborn against its mother, skin to skin.

Pas satisfaisant\nEncouragez les parents.en:
Not Satisfactory
Encourage parents to ensure their children's vaccination schedules are up to date and remind them of the importance of vaccination for their protection against disease. Identify with them the reasons for the vaccination delay and any potential challenges encountered in accessing vaccines.
During the individual meeting, inform the supervisor that not all children aged 0 to 23 months are up to date with their vaccinations. Encourage them to work with the CHW to identify the obstacles encountered and implement actions to improve vaccination coverage in the community. Make this a priority discussion point with the CHW supervisor and, if necessary, with the CHW themselves to ensure immediate action and specific follow-up for children with delayed vaccinations.

Satisfaisant\nFélicitez les parents pour.en:
Satisfactory
Congratulate parents for keeping their children up-to-date with their vaccinations and remind them of the importance of maintaining this protection against disease. Encourage them to continue adhering to the vaccination schedule and to educate other parents about its importance. Ask them if they are experiencing any challenges accessing vaccines and discuss possible solutions to overcome these challenges.

Pas satisfaisant\nInformez les membres d.en:
Not Satisfactory
Inform household members that care is completely free and covered by the NGO in all its intervention areas. If a payment has been made, whether formal or informal, reassure them that this situation should not be occurring and ask for further details on the circumstances. Assure them that you will report this situation to the appropriate officials to ensure that health care and services are truly free.
During the individual meeting, inform the supervisor that payments have been reported for care and services in an area where they should be completely free. Ask them to investigate with the CHW concerned and ensure that free care is strictly respected, reminding the workers and the community that these services are covered by the NGO.

Not Satisfactory
Inform household members that all services provided by the CHW are completely free, even in a health area with payment restrictions for other care. If a payment has been made to the CHW, ask for further details and reassure them that this situation should not occur. Assure them that you will report this issue to the appropriate management to ensure that the CHW's services are truly free.
During the individual meeting, inform the supervisor that a payment has been reported to the CHW, even though their services are completely free. Ask them to clarify this situation with the CHW in question and ensure that the free service provision is strictly respected, reminding CHWs and the community that this care should not be charged under any circumstances.

Not Satisfactory
Inform household members that care and services for children under 59 months, pregnancy, childbirth, postpartum follow-up, family planning, and surgical procedures are completely free in this health area, including in cases of referral. If payment has been made for these services, ask for further details and reassure them that this situation should not occur.

Assure them that you will report this issue to the appropriate authorities to ensure that this care is effectively free.

Ask her if she has encountered any difficulties accessing this treatment and discuss possible solutions to ensure her care.
